title: Helium Prices Quadrupled Between 2011 And 2013
hook: Helium prices quadrupled in 2 years when supply tightened.
closing: Medical and industrial users feel shortages long before party balloons do.
question: Which helium use matters most?

segments.say: Qatar holds 10.1 billion cubic meters, ahead of United States 8.7, Algeria 8.2, and Russia 6.8.
Helium demand is projected to rise from index 100 in 2024 to 190 in 2035.
Helium's price index jumped from 100 in 2011 to 400 in 2013.
